name: browser-use
headline: Temporal Awareness - Accurate Date Handling
short_description: Enables Claude to use the Unix date command for accurate temporal reasoning. Benefits operations teams by ensuring correct date handling, day of week calculations, and deadline tracking. Integrates with shell environments and workflows requiring precise time-based automation.
author: hodgesmr

sections.overview:
Temporal Awareness is an Agent Skill that instructs Claude to invoke the Unix date command when responding to date-related queries, deadline calculations, and day-of-week verifications. Claude's system prompt date can become stale or unavailable, leading to incorrect temporal reasoning—this skill solves that by running live date commands before responding. It supports both GNU date (Linux) and BSD date (macOS/FreeBSD) syntax, enabling accurate contract date verification, deadline tracking, and temporal calculations in automated workflows. Operations teams and workflow automation benefit from deterministic, real-time date handling instead of relying on potentially outdated system information.
Verify day-of-week alignment in contract proposals and legal documents
Calculate accurate deadlines and project timelines in automation workflows
Validate date accuracy when parsing temporal references from unstructured text
Adjust engagement start and end dates while maintaining correct day-of-week alignment
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/hodgesmr/temporal-awareness`
sections.usage:
```
Using the Unix date command, calculate the date 30 days from today for [COMPANY] [INDUSTRY] and provide the day of the week. Also, determine if this date falls on a weekend or a weekday. Format the output as a bullet point list.
```
Copy

```
# Date Calculation Results

- **Date 30 Days from Today**: 2023-11-15
- **Day of the Week**: Wednesday
- **Weekend/Weekday**: Weekday
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
